source.author: cic
source.text: Atque ut post Cannensem illam calamitatem primum Marcelli ad Nolam proelio populus se Romanus erexit posteaque prosperae res deinceps multae consecutae sunt, sic post rerum nostrarum et communium gravissimos casus nihil ante epistulam Bruti mihi accidit quod vellem aut quod aliqua ex parte sollicitudines allevaret meas.
source.text_original: Atque ut post Cannensem illam calamitatem primum Marcelli ad Nolam proelio populus se Romanus erexit posteaque prosperae res deinceps multae consecutae sunt, sic post rerum nostrarum et communium gravissimos casus nihil ante epistulam Bruti mihi accidit quod vellem aut quod aliqua ex parte sollicitudines allevaret meas.
source.text_english: And just as after that disaster at Cannae the Roman people first raised itself up in Marcellus’ battle at Nola, and then many favorable events followed in succession, so after the gravest misfortunes in our own affairs and in public affairs, nothing happened to me before Brutus’ letter that I either wished for or that in some degree relieved my anxieties.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: non sic post Trebiam, Trasumennum et Cannas, in quibus locis Romanorum exercituum caesa sunt milia, Marcelli primum apud Nolam proelio se populus Romanus erexit.
reuse.text_original: non sic post Trebiam, Trasumennum et Cannas, in quibus locis Romanorum exercituum caesa sunt milia, Marcelli primum apud Nolam proelio se populus Romanus erexit.
reuse.text_english: Not so after the Trebia, Trasimene, and Cannae, in which places thousands of Roman armies were slain, did the Roman people first lift themselves up in Marcellus’ battle at Nola.
